026246: // Whether a sizeof/_Alignof operand is a type name wrapped in its own
026247: // parentheses.  The word's own parentheses are already outside start..end, so
026248: // any strippable pair here was a second pair in the source -- and
026249: // `sizeof ((T))` is not C: the operand grammar is a unary expression or
026250: // `( type-name )` with exactly one pair, and `(T)` as an expression names a
026251: // type where a value is required.  Every resolver above correctly fails on
026252: // it, which left the int prediction to answer 4 -- and autoconf's
026253: // AC_CHECK_TYPE compiles exactly this shape and requires it to fail, so a
026254: // compiler that accepts it reports every type as absent: CPython's configure
026255: // lost clock_t, socklen_t, ssize_t, mode_t, off_t, pid_t and size_t at once,
026256: // and `#define size_t unsigned int` followed.

036261: // Is this C type a pointer to a variably modified array -- `char (*p)[width]`,
036262: // which musl's lsearch and lfind walk their tables with? Such a pointer never
036263: // reaches c_type_ir_map, because the array it addresses has no constant size.
036264: // It is the type `char p[][width]` adjusts to, so the local it becomes is the
036265: // same one an array parameter becomes: a pointer to the innermost element,
036266: // carrying the runtime dimension table that scales an index by the row size.
036267: // The pointee is what the caller hands the layout walk, which prepends the
036268: // absent outermost dimension.
